justification: Minor: data and test count only, no code. 17 Ashfield rules limited to the zones the council names (R3, E1, MU1) and 55 City of Sydney schedule rules limited to a named place with no outline are withheld (Green Square, Central Sydney, Late Night Management Areas, Local Centre Areas, City Living Area, Oxford Street). Applied live with owner go and a row backup; same step as #1679 and #1681.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Prints to-change greater than 0 after the apply.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before the apply it printed to-change=17 (Ashfield) and 55 (City of Sydney); after, 0 for both.

break_it.scenario: A reader's place or zone limit is wrong and a rule is hidden from a house it applies to.
break_it.how: Only rows with a verbatim quote that I re-found in the council text were used: 89 of 127 limited calls passed. Replay on 3 judged runs: 7 wrong rules hidden, 0 right-judged rules hidden.
break_it.repro: Quotes are in the scratch file scope_confirmed.json.

break_it.scenario: A house inside Green Square or Central Sydney loses a rule that applies to it.
break_it.what_happens: The rule is not shown to that house.
break_it.how: Accepted under the 2026-10-15 ruling that unmapped small-area rules are hidden. These 55 rows are not yet on the not-covered list, which waits for #1676 to merge.
break_it.repro: python scripts/derive_precinct_keys.py --only land_limits --council city_of_sydney prints to-change=0.

break_it.what_happens: The rules reach all houses again.
break_it.how: The step runs after every publish and matches by text fingerprint.
break_it.repro: Both councils print to-change=0 after the apply.

post_merge.manual_verify: A Darlington house no longer shows Green Square rules; not checked in a browser.
